## DebugModel component
- **Status:** Required
- **Type:** Constant Binding `Injects.DebugModel`

### Description
Represents the options visible in the default DebugOverlay Vue.

Has no implementation within the package so is required to be implemented by the game project.

Should implement the interface `IBaseDebugModel`.

### API

#### debugTicketOptions: unknown[];
An array representing all the options available. Displayed in the default DebugOverlay Vue.

An interface should be defined to replace unknown (See example `IDebugOption` below).


#### debugSettingOptions: IDebugSetting[];
An array representing all the options available. Displayed in the advanced section of the DebugOverlay Vue.

The type used in the array should implement IDebugSetting some examples are 

{
    name: 'number',
    type: 'number',
    currentValue: 5,
    onChange: (val: string | number | boolean | undefined) => {
        // eslint-disable-next-line
        console.log('number triggered = ' + val);
    }
},
{
    name: 'trigger',
    type: 'trigger',
    onChange: () => {
        // eslint-disable-next-line
        console.log('trigger triggered');
    }
}

values can be set and when the current value is changed in the panel the onChange method will be called

#### readonly shouldSendDebugData: boolean;
Internally checked by the GameServer in *Begin* calls to determine if `debugServerData` should be appended to the message before sending.

> :warning: **Is never checked when environment === live

#### readonly debugServerData: unknown;
Represents the data that is actually appended to the Begin Message when shouldSendDebugData is true.
An interface should be defined to replace unknown. What is required in that interface will be determined by Engine (See example `IDebugData` below).

#### updateDebugOption(option: unknown): void;
Internally called by the default DebugOverlay Vue when any option is clicked.

### BareBones Example
```ts
// file debug-model.ts

import { eventEmitter, events, IBaseDebugModel } from '@arcade-client/base-package';

// This should describe the structure the Server is expecting to force game states
export interface IDebugData {
    DebugTicket: number[];
}

export interface IDebugOption {
    name: string;
    data: IDebugData;
}

export class DebugModel implements IBaseDebugModel {
    public static get Instance(): DebugModel { return this._instance || (this._instance = new DebugModel()); }
    private static _instance: DebugModel;

    public readonly debugTicketOptions: IDebugOption[] = [
        {
            name: 'Clear',
            data: {
                DebugTicket: []
            }
        },
        // Some example options
        /* {
            name: 'No-Win',
            data: {
                DebugTicket: []
            }
        } */
        /* {
            name: 'Small-Win',
            data: {
                DebugTicket: []
            }
        } */
        /* {
            name: 'Big-Win',
            data: {
                DebugTicket: []
            }
        } */
        /* {
            name: 'Bonus',
            data: {
                DebugTicket: [],
                DebugBonus: []
            }
        } */
    ];

    // Initialise to the empty option
    public selectedOption: IDebugOption = this.debugTicketOptions[0];

    public get shouldSendDebugData(): boolean {
        return this.selectedOption.data.DebugTicket.length > 1;
    }

    public get debugServerData(): IDebugData {
        return this.selectedOption.data;
    }

    private constructor() { }

    public updateDebugOption(option: IDebugOption): void {
        // Update the model
        this.selectedOption = option;

        // Fire the TOGGLE_DEBUG_OVERLAY event with the param false to tell the package to hide the debug view
        eventEmitter.emit(events.POPUP.TOGGLE_DEBUG_OVERLAY, false);
    }
}

export const debugModel = DebugModel.Instance;
```
